tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: DNS records for a domain (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS by default; also CNAME, SOA).

tools.name: whois
tools.description: WHOIS registration data for a domain: registrar, creation and expiry dates, name servers.

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.description: TLS certificate of a host: validity, issuer, expiry, days remaining, SAN.

tools.name: ip_geolocation
tools.description: Geolocation of an IP address: country, city, ISP, coordinates, timezone.

tools.name: email_validate
tools.description: Validate an email address: syntax, MX records, SMTP check, disposable and role-based detection.

tools.name: ip_blacklist
tools.description: Check an IPv4 address against 3 DNS blacklists (Barracuda, SpamCop, UCEPROTECT).

tools.name: http_headers
tools.description: HTTP response headers and status of a public URL (HEAD request, redirects followed and checked).

tools.name: subnet_calc
tools.description: IPv4 subnet calculator from CIDR: network, broadcast, netmask, wildcard, host range, host count.

tools.name: domain_audit
tools.description: AI security audit of a domain: DNS, SPF, DMARC, TLS, HTTP security headers, WHOIS expiry and IP blacklists, returned as a 0-100 score, findings by severity and exact fixes. Requires a paid ipv4.fr API key (X-Api-Key header); uses 10 requests of the daily limit. Without a key, pay per call with x402

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_validate · Private data: dns_lookup, email_validate, domain_audit · Public sink: email_validate, subnet_calc.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_validate · Private data: dns_lookup, email_validate, domain_audit · Public sink: email_validate, subnet_calc

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
